name: Securities Financing Transaction Details 58
definition: Details of the closing of the securities financing transaction.

SecuritiesFinancingTradeIdentification.name: Securities Financing Trade Identification
SecuritiesFinancingTradeIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the underlying securities financing trade as assigned by the instructing party. The identification is common to all collateral pieces (one or many).

SecuritiesFinancingUniqueTransactionIden.name: Securities Financing Unique Transaction Identifier
SecuritiesFinancingUniqueTransactionIden.definition: Unique Transaction Identifier (UTI) as agreed with the other counterparty.

ClosingLegIdentification.name: Closing Leg Identification
ClosingLegIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the second leg of the transaction as known by the account owner (or the instructing party acting on its behalf).

TerminationDate.name: Termination Date
TerminationDate.definition: Closing date/time or maturity date/time of the transaction.

RateChangeDate.name: Rate Change Date
RateChangeDate.definition: Date/Time at which rate change has taken place.

EarliestCallBackDate.name: Earliest Call Back Date
EarliestCallBackDate.definition: Earliest date/time at which the call back can take place.

CommissionCalculationDate.name: Commission Calculation Date
CommissionCalculationDate.definition: Date/time at which the commission is calculated.

RateType.name: Rate Type
RateType.definition: Specifies whether the rate is fixed or variable.

Revaluation.name: Revaluation
Revaluation.definition: Specifies whether the collateral position should be subject to automatic revaluation by the account servicer.

InterestComputationMethod.name: Interest Computation Method
InterestComputationMethod.definition: Identifies the computation method of accrued interest of the related financial instrument.

MaturityDateModification.name: Maturity Date Modification
MaturityDateModification.definition: Indicates whether the maturity date of the securities financing transaction may be modified.

InterestPayment.name: Interest Payment
InterestPayment.definition: Indicates whether the interest is to be paid to the collateral taker. If set to no, the interest is paid to the collateral giver.

VariableRateSupport.name: Variable Rate Support
VariableRateSupport.definition: Index or support rate used together with the spread to calculate the repurchase rate.

RepurchaseRate.name: Repurchase Rate
RepurchaseRate.definition: Rate to be used to recalculate the repurchase amount.

StockLoanMargin.name: Stock Loan Margin
StockLoanMargin.definition: Percentage mark-up on a loan consideration used to reflect the lender's risk.

SecuritiesHaircut.name: Securities Haircut
SecuritiesHaircut.definition: Haircut or valuation factor on the security expressed as a percentage.

ChargesRate.name: Charges Rate
ChargesRate.definition: Interest rate paid in the context of a securities financing transaction.

PricingRate.name: Pricing Rate
PricingRate.definition: Interest rate to be paid on the transaction amount, as agreed between the counterparties.

Spread.name: Spread
Spread.definition: Repurchase spread expressed as a rate; margin over or under an index that determines the repurchase rate.

TransactionCallDelay.name: Transaction Call Delay
TransactionCallDelay.definition: Minimum number of days' notice a counterparty needs for terminating the transaction.

TotalNumberOfCollateralInstructions.name: Total Number Of Collateral Instructions
TotalNumberOfCollateralInstructions.definition: Total number of collateral instructions involved in the transaction.

LocalBrokerCommission.name: Local Broker Commission
LocalBrokerCommission.definition: Amount of commission paid to a local broker.

DealAmount.name: Deal Amount
DealAmount.definition: Principal amount of a trade (for second leg).

AccruedInterestAmount.name: Accrued Interest Amount
AccruedInterestAmount.definition: Interest amount that has accrued in between coupon payment periods.

ForfeitAmount.name: Forfeit Amount
ForfeitAmount.definition: Fixed amount of money that has to be paid (instead of interest) in the case of a recall or at the closing date.

PremiumAmount.name: Premium Amount
PremiumAmount.definition: Difference between the amount of money of the first leg and the amount of the second leg of the transaction.

TerminationAmountPerPieceOfCollateral.name: Termination Amount Per Piece Of Collateral
TerminationAmountPerPieceOfCollateral.definition: Amount of money to be settled per piece of collateral to terminate the transaction.

TerminationTransactionAmount.name: Termination Transaction Amount
TerminationTransactionAmount.definition: Total amount of money to be settled to terminate the transaction.

SecondLegNarrative.name: Second Leg Narrative
SecondLegNarrative.definition: Provides additional information about the second leg in narrative form.
